items.headline: Creel throws 4 of 5 TD passes to Williams as Jacksonville State beats Eastern Kentucky 49-7
items.description: — Caden Creel threw four of his five touchdown passes to Jamill Williams to lead Jacksonville State to a 49-7 victory over Eastern Kentucky on Saturday night.

items.headline: North Dakota State opens its FBS era with a 33-7 win over Jacksonville State
items.description: — Nathan Hayes threw two touchdown passes to help North Dakota State roll past Jacksonville State 33-7 in the Football Bowl Subdivision debut for the Bison and season opener for both teams on Saturday.

items.headline: North Dakota State cruises in Bison's first-ever FBS game
items.description: Nathan Hayes completed 14 of 22 passes with two touchdowns and Myles Mitchell ran for 74 yards as North Dakota State, a former FCS power that owns 10 national titles, raced to a 33-7 win over Jacksonville State in the Bison's first FBS game.
